title: ASNER: Software Architecture Recovery with Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement
title_zh: ASNER：基于自适应语义邻域与证据锚定细化的软件架构恢复

paragraphs.en: ASNER通过自适应语义邻域与证据锚定细化实现软件架构恢复，多指标显著超越现有方法。 Automated software architecture recovery provides architectural context for software engineering and repository-level LLM agents. Existing methods combine structural and semantic signals, but functional relatedness does not necessarily imply shared architectural responsibility. Fixed thresholds or Top-K neighborhoods also ignore repository scale and local similarity distributions, introducing errors that propagate through clustering. Unconstrained LLM refinement may further alter correct assignments without sufficient evidence. We propose ASNER (Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement for Software Architecture Recovery), based on responsibility-aware, project-adaptive relation modeling and evidence-grounded boundary verification. ASNER derives structured file responsibilities with an LLM, constructs semantic neighborhoods that adapt to repository scale and local similarity distributions, and augments a static dependency graph with selected semantic relations and weak directory cues. Community detection recovers the component backbone. A Responsibility-Ownership-Aware (ROA) Agent then examines uncertain boundary files using project-level responsibilities and traceable code evidence, changing assignments only when supported. Experiments on 12 open-source projects spanning C, C++, Java, and Python show that ASNER achieves the best macro-average on all five metrics on the common benchmark, improving ARI and c2c@66 over GAER-GAT by 19.5% and 32.9%, respectively. A downstream evaluation shows that ASNER-guided LocAgent improves file-, module-, and function-level code localization, demonstrating the value of its architectural context for repository-level software engineering tasks.
paragraphs.zh: ASNER通过自适应语义邻域与证据锚定细化实现软件架构恢复，多指标显著超越现有方法。自动化软件架构恢复为软件工程和仓库级大语言模型智能体提供架构上下文。 现有方法结合了结构信号与语义信号，但功能相关性并不必然意味着共享架构职责。 固定阈值或Top-K邻域还忽略了仓库规模和局部相似度分布，引入会在聚类中传播的错误。 不受约束的大语言模型细化可能在证据不足的情况下进一步改变原本正确的归属。 我们提出ASNER（自适应语义邻域与证据锚定细化的软件架构恢复方法），其基础是职责感知的、项目自适应的关系建模和证据锚定的边界验证。 ASNER利用大语言模型推导结构化的文件职责，构建能适应仓库规模和局部相似度分布的语义邻域，并用筛选后的语义关系和弱目录线索增强静态依赖图。 社区发现恢复了组件主干。 随后，一个职责所有权感知（ROA）智能体利用项目级职责和可追溯的代码证据检查不确定的边界文件，仅在有依据支持时才更改归属。 在涵盖C、C++、Java和Python的12个开源项目上的实验表明，ASNER在通用基准的全部五项指标上均取得最佳宏平均值，相比GAER-GAT，ARI和c2c@66分别提升19.5%和32.9%。 下游评估表明，ASNER引导的LocAgent改进了文件级、模块级和函数级的代码定位，证明了其架构上下文对仓库级软件工程任务的价值。
